g.text: Exact denominators are printed on every completion bar. *DeepSeek replay is 21/21 among terminal retained records, not 21/33 scheduled cells. Operational rates are

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #66737d

g.text: descriptive: provider, task coverage, harness version and recovery policy differ. Cached tokens are cached input, not repeated model output; providers are not pooled into

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #66737d

g.text: a scientific contrast. Later recovery-amended seed-0 pilots are excluded from this frozen baseline.
